digest.component_or_area: plan-review clarity measure and deterministic floor
propositions: The current clarity_score rewards volume and shape over adherence to author-guide leaf/container contracts, allowing padded tickets to pass without grounded Approach or Scope.
Clarity criteria are duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py without unified parsing, inviting drift and maintenance debt when extending.

Deterministic checks for required-section shape (keyed to graph altitude), per-AC verification coverage, placeholder-free scope, and AC text hygiene can be mechanically implemented without semantic judgment.
AC verification must distinguish operator-attested items from those with explicit proving clauses (verified by, check by) to measure provability coverage reliably.

Author-guide and authoritative G6 documentation conflict on whether rejected alternatives are required; bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82 tracks this, and clarity should not enforce rejected-alternative prose until resolved.
